name: Accutech Packaging
old_description: Accutech specializes in providing tailored packaging solutions for a variety of industries, including mail order fulfillment, food processing and general manufacturing. As the North American representative of Beck Packautomaten, Accutech offers durable and versatile machines designed for high-output industrial use.
about:
Accutech Packaging is based in Foxborough, Massachusetts. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It operates as a designer and manufacturer of custom packaging systems and equipment, and serves as the North American representative for Beck Packautomaten.

The company designs and manufactures custom packaging systems and equipment for fulfillment, food processing, and general manufacturing. It also integrates standard packaging equipment such as Combi case packers, 3M case sealers, ID Technologies label applicators, and Sealed Air protective packaging systems into complete lines. Accutech supplies a full line of packaging materials and operates a warehouse and fleet of trucks for order fulfillment and delivery. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Accutech serves customers in electronics, e-commerce and retail, food manufacturing, pharmaceutical and life sciences, and food and medical packaging. Its solutions target mail order fulfillment, food processing, and general manufacturing operations.

The company emphasizes a team-based approach drawing on decades of industry expertise, a no-cost consulting service to evaluate customer needs, and a commitment to continuous improvement through quality management systems. It positions its ability to integrate multiple equipment brands into turnkey lines as a key differentiator.
